answer: Publish the replication cost of every identity class and recompute it each epoch: bond, hardware, distinct peers, hours of real work. Publish failures too, with the account graph attached. Incentives do the rest. An attacker who wants to wander into 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 bonds, find peers who are not his own recruits, and accept that any single failure prints the whole cluster. The pearl of a good record is worth less than the basalt of a published failure costs.
